# Punarjanam by Yogini Mansi

> Drop-in yoga, signature retreats and spiritual experiences by the Ganga in Rishikesh, India. No teacher training or certification.

- [Home](https://www.punarjanam.org/)
- [drop-in-yoga.html](https://www.punarjanam.org/drop-in-yoga.html)
- [retreats.html](https://www.punarjanam.org/retreats.html)
- [spiritual-experiences.html](https://www.punarjanam.org/spiritual-experiences.html)
- [about.html](https://www.punarjanam.org/about.html)
- [contact.html](https://www.punarjanam.org/contact.html)
- [Three-Day Retreat](https://www.punarjanam.org/retreats/three-day-retreat.html): 3 days, price on enquiry
- [Five-Day Retreat](https://www.punarjanam.org/retreats/five-day-retreat.html): 5 days, price on enquiry
- [Rudrabhishek](https://www.punarjanam.org/spiritual/rudrabhishek.html): A Vedic offering to Lord Shiva.
- [Havan by the Ganga](https://www.punarjanam.org/spiritual/havan-by-the-ganga.html): A sacred fire ritual beside the river.
- [Ganga Aarti Experience](https://www.punarjanam.org/spiritual/ganga-aarti.html): Evening lamps, chants and bells on the river.
- [Ganga Snan & Deep Daan](https://www.punarjanam.org/spiritual/ganga-snan-deep-daan.html): A holy dip, and a lamp offered to the river.
- [Seva & Annadan Experience](https://www.punarjanam.org/spiritual/seva-annadan.html): Service, and the offering of food.
